log.msg: Finding 1 (confirmed regression) was real: my original grip.css rewrite silently dropped html.grip-sizing{--rail-ease:0s;cursor:ew-resize;user-select:none} — missed it because I rewrote the file with Write instead of a targeted Edit and didn't diff line-by-line against the original afterward. Lesson for next time: after a full-file Write on a file with existing behavior to preserve, diff old-vs-new before considering it done, not just node --check.

Verifying the fix needed a real Playwright pointer session (page.mouse.down/up), not a raw el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(...)) with a made-up pointerId — the browser throws NotFoundError on setPointerCapture for a pointerId with no real active pointer, silently aborting the handler before it reached html.classList.add(). A bare dispatchEvent happened to still work for the touch-drag proof because it only needed write() to fire (gated in pointermove, not pointerdown), not the classList changes finding 1 is about.
